content:
As a Jira administrator, you can associate a work type scheme with multiple spaces to better manage work types in one go. Your space administrators can also select a work type scheme based on the work types they need in each of their spaces.
How to associate a work type scheme with a space
- Select Settings (), then select Work items.
- In the Work types section, select Work type schemes.
- Select Associate for the scheme you want to associate with a space.
- Find the spaces you want to associate with the scheme and select Associate.
How Jira administrators manage work type schemes
- Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings.
- Select Work types, then Actions, then select Use a different scheme.
- Choose one of the three options: 
  - If you know the work type scheme name, select an existing work type scheme.
  - If you know which space you want to copy, choose a scheme from an existing space.
  - If you want to create a new scheme with default work types, choose a new scheme to be associated with your current space.
- When you have selected a scheme, select OK.
